J500-J400 final AbsRel-0.00268490 and F1+0.02007426 have CIs excluding zero, but F1 seed signs differ(-0.00295708,+0.04310560), reflecting the weaker J400 second-seed final. Other three intervals cross zero. No inference yet about the still-unpaired third seed.

J500-L500 best AbsRel-0.00150199 CI[-0.00284619,-0.00029403],delta1+0.00234351 CI[0.00020578,0.00463940],band-0.00296992 CI[-0.00501837,-0.00123683] improve. RMSE and F1 cross zero. The second seed has essentially equal AbsRel (difference+6.5e-9), worse RMSE/delta1, and better F1/band; do not claim all seeds improve all metrics.
J500-L500 final: AbsRel,RMSE,delta1,band improve in both seeds with CIs excluding zero; F1 crosses zero with opposite seed signs.

J500-R500 best: AbsRel-0.00660077 and band-0.01036138 improve with CIs excluding zero. RMSE,delta1,F1 cross zero; F1 seed signs differ. Final only RMSE-0.02288899 and band-0.01027807 have CIs excluding zero; final AbsRel-0.00592582 crosses zero despite both seeds improving.

Against B0, four depth/band metrics improve at both endpoints in both seeds with scene CIs excluding zero; F1 gains remain uncertain. Final-best all five CIs cross zero. Both seeds final AbsRel worsens slightly and F1 improves slightly; band signs differ.

Intervals use image-weighted paired differences averaged across the same available seeds and2000 scene resamples over62scenes,seed320119. Conditional scene uncertainty is separate from training-seed SD; no multiple-testing correction. Wait for seed320114.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0246: Minor endpoint difference:AbsRel0.1685->0.1677,F1 0.485->0.481. Foreground matched contour remains; shelf-top fragments shrink, false ceiling boundary persists, and broad wall errors remain worse than B0.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0080: Clear local endpoint regression:AbsRel0.0581->0.0623,F1 0.489->0.220,predicted edges461->160. Many long central/lower shelf vertical matches disappear, leaving mainly top/cap fragments. Raw depth is finite,positive and nonconstant; the visual silhouette still exists, so this is weakened depth discontinuities rather than a missing output. This occurs despite the run satisfying overall-AbsRel stability.

interpretation: Two-seed J500 improves several overall-depth measures versus matched L500/R500, but first-seed F1 tradeoffs do not generalize uniformly. Seed320113 has essentially tied best AbsRel with L500. Global numerical stability coexists with severe local shelf-edge decline; all positive and negative evidence is retained while the third seed runs.
